title: Funky Ehh
blurb: The Funky Ehh sound — a groove-plus-grunt combination that soundtracked a wave of dance edits and made 'ehh' a rhythmic instrument. It's silly, it's danceable, and it demonstrates the internet's core talent: taking a meaningless vocal noise and building an entire trend on top of it.
origin: A viral dance-edit sound built around a rhythmic 'ehh'.
